title: Apple Reminders bidirectional adapter configuration
description: Per-household configuration consumed by packs/adapters/reminders/apple-eventkit/adapter.py at start(). The Reminders adapter does not use a 1Password reference — EventKit access is granted at the OS level via EKEventStore.requestFullAccessToReminders (prompt 16 bootstrap-wizard wires the grant). sensitivity_floor is a hardcoded const `"normal"` at the pack level per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10 — adapters never auto-elevate, so any config that tries to raise it to `"privileged"` is rejected by JSON-schema validation before the loader runs. The never-sync filter is the per-item privacy boundary applied at BOTH inbound and outbound boundaries inside the adapter.

target_list_identifier.description: The iCloud Reminders list identifier (EKCalendar.calendarIdentifier) that AdministrateMe writes household-tagged reminders to on the 30s outbound loop. Inbound polls fetch from ALL non-never-sync lists; outbound writes go only to this list.

member_id.description: Household member whose separately enrolled bridge owns the EventKit grant for this adapter instance. The current schema cannot represent the planned CoS service principal.

provider_account_id.description: Stable content-free reference for the member's iCloud Reminders account; it must not equal the member, enrollment, or service-principal identifier.

deployment_target.description: This current human-member schema runs only inside the separately supervised member bridge.

workspace.description: Current member Apple sources remain in the member's personal workspace.

permission_scope.description: Exact reviewed EventKit Reminders permission capabilities.

allowed_container_ids.description: Exact reviewed Reminders list identifiers this bridge may read. The write list must be included.

shared_container_ids.description: Subset explicitly promoted by AdministrateMe to household visibility; native iCloud sharing never grants this automatically.

binding_provenance.description: The member bridge enrollment is the binding authority for this OS-permission provider.

ownership_attested.description: Explicit review that the provider account and bridge belong to this member.

never_sync_list_substrings.description: List names containing any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are blocked from sync at BOTH boundaries. Default matches the canonical never-sync rules in BUILD.md APPLE REMINDERS BIDIRECTIONAL §"Never-sync rules".

never_sync_tag_substrings.description: Reminders whose title or notes contain any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are blocked from sync at BOTH boundaries. Default is the canonical `#private` tag.

inbound_poll_interval_s.description: Seconds between inbound EventKit provider-watch cycles.

outbound_poll_interval_s.description: Seconds between outbound EventKit write batches. The adapter drains only confirmed upstream state (`reminder.dispatched` / `task.created`) at this cadence; unconfirmed proposals remain in Triage.

emit_schema_version.description: Emit the rich list/reminder contract including recurrence, geofences, completion timestamps, URL links, and date components.

sensitivity_floor.description: Hardcoded constant per SYSTEM_INVARIANTS.md §6 invariant 10. Reminders adapters cannot be elevated to `"privileged"` through configuration; item privacy is enforced by the never-sync boundary.
